name: AWS EC2 Price List API - US East (N. Virginia), current
notes: AWS's own machine-readable price list, 481 MB JSON, offerCode AmazonEC2, version 20260925174521 (publicationDate 2026-09-25T17:45:21Z). Authoritative: it is the same feed the AWS Pricing Calculator and billing system consume. Prices extracted for Linux/Shared tenancy/no pre-installed software/capacitystatus=Used, unit=Hrs, us-east-1. NOTE the feed carries an explicit $0.00 entry alongside the real rate for several p5/p4d SKUs (p5.48xlarge, p5.4xlarge, p5en.48xlarge, p4d.24xlarge); that is the 'no capacity' sentinel, not a free GPU. p5e.48xlarge and trn2/trn2u are absent from this region file entirely - AWS does not publish an on-demand rate for them there, which is itself the capacity story.
